description: M2 + M3 (shared root cause): fix the funnel completions count to use the true range-scoped total when no cross-question filter is active, and disclose the 5000-row sampling in the reports UI. Spans apps/api getFormReport + apps/web FormReportsPage. Independent of FEAT-001/003/004.
steps: M3 server: in getFormReport (apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts), add a range-scoped count to the existing Promise.all using the existing responseWhere object: prisma.formResponse.count({ where: responseWhere }) (name it e.g. rangeScopedTotal). responseWhere already folds in the submittedAt date range when hasRange, so this is range-correct.

M3 server: replace `const completions = sampledResponses;` (~L3351) so that when NO filter is active (!filterApplied) completions = rangeScopedTotal, and when a filter IS active completions = sampledResponses (preserving current behavior; computeFunnel already nulls the conversion %s when filterActive). Do not change computeFunnel.
M3 server: keep sampledResponses used for per-question aggregates, skipped, avgTime, sectionCompleteness exactly as-is.

M2 server: add sampled: boolean, sampleCap: number (= REPORT_SAMPLE_CAP), sampledCount: number (= sampledResponses) to the getFormReport return object. sampled = (no filter) ? rangeScopedTotal > REPORT_SAMPLE_CAP : responses.length === REPORT_SAMPLE_CAP (filter runs over the already-capped in-memory sample).

M2/M3 tests: extend apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.test.ts. Assert completions-branch and sampled derivation as PURE unit tests with no DB — if needed, extract and export a tiny pure helper (e.g. selectCompletions(rangeScopedTotal, sampledResponses, filterActive) and/or deriveSampled(rangeScopedTotal, sampledLen, cap, filterActive)) and test it directly, matching how computeFunnel is exported+tested. Keep computeFunnel's own behavior covered.
M2 web type: in apps/web/src/pages/FormReportsPage.tsx add `sampled: boolean; sampleCap: number; sampledCount: number;` to the FormReport type (~L99-124) to stay in sync with the server payload.

M2 web banner: when report.sampled is true, render a note using the existing `inline-banner` CSS class (same pattern as the refetchError banner ~L343), placed near the top of the loaded report (e.g. just before <StatCards>), reading like 'Showing analytics based on the most recent 5,000 responses of N total' via report.sampleCap.toLocaleString() and report.totalResponses.toLocaleString(). Match existing dashboard styling; no new CSS.
Do NOT touch the existing '+ N more responses' text on the 20-item text sample (~L730).
acceptance_criteria: With no filter and > 5000 in-range responses, funnel.completions equals the true range-scoped count (not capped at 5000); with a filter active, completions and null conversion %s are unchanged.
The report payload includes sampled/sampleCap/sampledCount and the web FormReport type matches it (typecheck passes across the boundary).
FormReportsPage shows a tasteful inline-banner note only when sampled is true; the '+N more responses' text is unchanged.
New server unit tests for the completions branch and the sampled flag pass with no DB.
cd apps/api typecheck + pnpm test green; cd apps/web typecheck + pnpm build:web + pnpm test green.
verification: cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit  (expect exit 0)
cd apps/api && pnpm test  (expect green incl new completions/sampled tests)
cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit  (expect exit 0)
findings:
Implemented in apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts and apps/web/src/pages/FormReportsPage.tsx.

Server (form.service.ts):
- Added two exported pure helpers next to computeFunnel: selectCompletions(rangeScopedTotal, sampledResponses, filterActive) and deriveSampled(rangeScopedTotal, sampledLen, cap, filterActive). Same export+unit-test pattern as computeFunnel.
- getFormReport Promise.all now also fetches rangeScopedTotal = prisma.formResponse.count({ where: responseWhere }) (range-correct; responseWhere folds in submittedAt range). Destructure order is [responses, totalResponses, rangeScopedTotal, views, starts, submissions].
- completions now = selectCompletions(rangeScopedTotal, sampledResponses, filterApplied): true range-scoped total when no filter, sampled count when a filter is active (computeFunnel still nulls conversion %s then). computeFunnel unchanged. sampledResponses still drives per-question aggregates/skipped/avgTime/sectionCompleteness unchanged.
- Return object gained sampled (deriveSampled over responses.length — the pre-filter capped page length), sampleCap (=REPORT_SAMPLE_CAP=5000), sampledCount (=sampledResponses).

Web (FormReportsPage.tsx):
- FormReport type extended with sampled: boolean; sampleCap: number; sampledCount: number; (typecheck confirms payload parity across the boundary).
- Added an inline-banner notice rendered only when report.sampled, placed just before <StatCards>, text: 'Showing analytics based on the most recent {sampleCap.toLocaleString()} responses of {totalResponses.toLocaleString()} total.' No new CSS. The '+N more responses' text at ~L730 was NOT touched.

Tests (form.service.test.ts): added selectCompletions and deriveSampled describe blocks (pure, no DB), imported both new helpers. API tests now 75 pass (was 64 baseline). Web tests 57 pass unchanged.

Verification all green: apps/api tsc --noEmit exit 0; apps/api pnpm test 75 pass; apps/web tsc -b --noEmit exit 0; root pnpm build:web success; apps/web pnpm test 57 pass.

Payload contract for later steps: getFormReport now always returns sampled/sampleCap/sampledCount alongside totalResponses; any other FormReport-type consumers must stay a strict superset match.
